name: Tekila Cocina Mexicana
notes: 3 legible photos: 1) a specials/house-specialties page, 2) a laminated specials table card, 3) the full main menu (appetizers/salads/soups/kids/combinations/seafood/desserts). Items appearing on both 1 & 2 (Monster Burrito, Enchiladas Rancheras, Enchiladas Trio, Lobster Enchiladas, Mahi Mahi Tacos, Trio Tacos) were merged into one entry, preferring photo 2's wording when descriptions differed. Trio Tacos' third meat reads 'carnitas' on photo 1 but 'pork belly' on photo 2; used photo 2's wording. Caesar Salad's 'add grilled chicken' upcharge line was skipped as a modifier.
